name: UpdateTemplate

parameters.help_en: The template name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and can be up to 200 characters in length. The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, or ALICLOUD
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称。内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度200字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD开头
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en: The template content. The content is in JSON or YAML format and can be up to 64 KB in size
parameters.help_zh: 模板内容。JSON或YAML格式，长度限制为 64 KB
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The tag keys and values. You can specify 1 to 20 key-value pairs
parameters.help_zh: 标签键及值，键值对数量限制为1至20
parameters.name: tags

CreatedBy.description_en: The user who created the template

CreatedDate.description_en: The time when the template was created

HasTrigger.description_en: Indicates whether the template was triggered successfully

Hash.description_en: The SHA-256 value of the template content

ShareType.description_en: The sharing type of the template. The sharing type of user-created templates is Private
ShareType.description_zh: 模板共享类型。目前用户创建的模板的共享类型均为 Private

Tags.description_en: The tag keys and values. You can specify 1 to 20 key-value pairs
Tags.description_zh: 标签键及值，键值对数量限制为1至20

TemplateFormat.description_en: The template format. The system automatically determines the format, which is JSON or YAML
TemplateFormat.description_zh: 模板格式。系统字段判断，为JSON或YAML

TemplateVersion.description_en: The template version. The version is in the format of "v" followed by a number, starting from 1
TemplateVersion.description_zh: 模板版本。以“v”+数字的形式，数字从1开始

UpdatedBy.description_en: The user who last updated the template

UpdatedDate.description_en: The time when the template was last updated
